# 論理エンティティ（JSON の記録）

| `demand` | Demand | `demand_id` | `demands` | — | — | 汎用の記録 |

## 記録を持たない識別子

- `relationship_id`：groups the revisions of one employment or contract relationship
- `facility_id`：part of the planning scope (facility/department)
- `department_id`：part of the planning scope (facility/department)
- `grant_cycle_id`：groups the grants of one leave cycle
- `rule_id`：identifier of a statutory rule in the rule catalogue
- `external_event_id`：identifier in the HR source ledger (outside the application)
- `setting_id`：name of a planning scope workflow setting (one record per scope and name)
